problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization permits nonconvex components and objectives. F has a global lower bound lower with F(x0)−lower≤Δ; no minimizer or convexity is required.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Every reply is an exact component gradient, for every call index and oracle seed. There is no oracle error or stochastic noise assumption; algorithmic randomization is allowed.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query chooses any component i and point x and receives ∇f_i(x). Each individual evaluation counts as one oracle call.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/FiniteSumSmoothNonconvex.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Average squared smoothness: (1/n)Σ_i‖∇f_i(x)−∇f_i(y)‖²≤L²‖x−y‖². A common componentwise L-Lipschitz bound is not required. The ambient space is an arbitrary complete real inner-product space. All parameters E,n,L,Δ,ε,x0 are public, with L>0, Δ≥0, ε>0.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm_squared
accuracy.details: Output X∈E must be measurable, its squared objective-gradient norm integrable, and E‖∇F(X)‖²≤ε². No last-iterate requirement is imposed.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Accuracy is in expectation under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law. Oracle cost is bounded for every seed by the prescribed fixed budget.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: This is the established smooth nonconvex finite-sum stationarity benchmark with exact component gradients and average squared smoothness, formulated in a general Hilbert space.
